revision_semantics: Content fingerprint excludes observations. Ordered source observations retain recurrence and source lineage; earliest content observation is preserved. Before normalization, the versioned fina_indicator source policy selects corrected flag 1 over initial flag 0 within one observation group.
availability_semantics: operational selects last actual observation; vendor selects vendor time then observation time, tied incompatible content fails. Universe selects a complete reconstructed state.
missing_semantics: null retains explicit missing reason; no forward fill across revisions

source_revision_policy.conflict_semantics: Unknown flags or differing payloads within the same flag fail. Across observation groups retain normal PIT ordering. Raw payload remains unchanged.
